body: Agent reply-tool messages (send_text kind "reply") go silent; only Stop turn answers pass notify=true. Alternative: loud replies, rejected because the task lists only Stop answers and the reply tool is compat-only duplicate output.

/brief and /full output, delivery-failure notices, Resume offers, separators, blocks and status all silent. Loud: Stop answer (send_text notify=true, answer_ops Op::Stream notify=true, long-answer document), permission prompts (send_prompts), TASK-033 block-done reply. Alternative: loud /brief output as a user-requested result, rejected: not in the listed loud set.

merge_lines stops at the first queued line of its topic whose notify differs from the head (break, not skip, to keep order). Alternative: rely on answers being merge=false, rejected because the task asks merge itself to keep notify.
